fullContent:
Niruryadi Gulika (Vati) 
 Reference – Sahasrayogam Vati Prakarana. 
 Introduction 
 Niruryadi Gulika (Vati) is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from mixture of herbs. This is present in the tablet form. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Aqueous extract of Udumbara – Ficus racemosa 
 Sita – Sugar 
 Kapitha – Feronia elephantum 
 Kumuda – Nelumbo nucifera 
 Niruri Moola – Sterculia foetida 
 Kataka – Strychnos potatorum 
 Chincha –Tamarindus indicus 
 Kantakari – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 Vairi – Salacia reticulata 
 Abhaya – Terminalia chebula 
 Amalaki – Emblica officinalis 
 Darvi – Berberis aristata 
 Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica 
 Turmeric – Curcuma longa 
 Usira – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Gairika – Purified Red ochre 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take the ingredients and powder them. 
 Mix all the ingredients with aqueous extract of udumbara to make its paste. 
 Make the pills from the paste. 
 
 Dose 
 Two pills, two times a day, after meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Controls blood sugar level 
 Type 2 diabetes 
 
 Contraindications 
 Strictly take under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
